title: Spec upgrade
description: Data, not code: moves a character file across a spec version that changed the file's shape. The spec's own upgrades are the items of `data/spec-upgrades.json`; `upgrade` runs each one between a character's `specVersion` and the engine's on the character, before the packs' upgrade scripts.

id.description: The spec version that made the change. A character written against an earlier version gets the steps.

path.description: A JSON Pointer into the character file, where a `*` segment matches every member of an array or object.

to.description: move: where it goes. Its `*` segments take, in order, the members `from`'s matched.

value.description: add: the value to write where there is none.
